Centre Denies Approving Land Acquisition for High-Speed Rail Corridors

The Centre has denied requesting land acquisition for three high-speed rail corridors, specifically clarifying that no such approval has been granted for corridors related to Hyderabad. This statement comes in response to reports or requests concerning these projects.
